d: Distinctive northern circumpolar constellation shaped like a W, marking the autumn and winter sky.

gaia-418551920284673408.x: Second-magnitude orange giant star anchoring the bottom vertex of the W-asterism.

hip-746.x: Delta Scuti pulsating variable subgiant star marking the westernmost point of the W-asterism.

gaia-510204838759030144.x: Algol-type eclipsing binary system forming the knee of the W-asterism.

gaia-425040000962559616.x: Nearby binary star system (~19.4 ly) featuring a solar-type G0V dwarf orbited by an orange K-type dwarf.

gaia-411413822074322432.x: High-velocity metal-poor Population II subgiant star orbiting through the galactic halo ~24.6 light-years away.

gaia-425940947659705600.x: Evolved yellow-orange giant star visible to the naked eye within the northern borders of Cassiopeia.
